audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were marked 'Skill' while whys[3] says 'you keep the poke edge' and whys[4] says 'you own the all-in'; the two-item row was given to Kennen while whys[6] says it flattens to a pick game.
audit.why: 64.63% over 82 games is a strongly favoured lane where Kennen owns everything from level 2 to first item, and only the late pick game evens out.
audit.corrected: L1 Skill, L2-L3 Kennen, Levels 4-5 Kennen, L6 Kennen, first item Kennen, 2+ items Skill. Matches the packet chart and the existing prose.

audit.why: Spikes are correctly placed at 2-3, 6 and first item for Kennen, with Neeko's threat window at 6+ on a clone-root into Pop Blossom. Slicing Maelstrom's flat 120s versus Pop Blossom's 120/105/90 means she out-cycles the ult trade later, which supports the late row flipping away from Kennen.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; spikes[0] and spikes[2] text corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly frames Kennen as out-ranging Neeko, but only her Q is shorter (800 vs your 950). Tangle-Barbs reaches 1000 — it out-ranges your poke — and that is the ability the advice tells you to respect. whys[2] also asserts 'she has no dash to escape your E', which the kit does not support.
audit.why: Neeko kit: Q Blooming Burst 800 range, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s; E Tangle-Barbs 1000 range, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, root that grows when it passes through a champion; R Pop Blossom carries a dash flag on the leap. Kennen Q is 950.
audit.corrected: You out-range her Q by 150 but not her root — sidestep Tangle-Barbs and commit in its 12s window rather than assuming distance protects you.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] and spikes[2] both describe Neeko as having a 'sub-200-HP frame'.
audit.why: No health figure of that kind exists anywhere in the data, and it is not true of a laning Neeko at first item. It reads as an invented stat.
audit.corrected: Replaced the fabricated HP claim with her real Tangle-Barbs cooldown as the window that makes the kill possible.

audit.why: packet flagged 'Your Thundering Shuriken' in early as a probable wrong name. Thundering Shuriken is the correct Riot name for Kennen's Q; the distance is only the attached leading word. False positive, no edit.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Neeko carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Both of you stay squishy, so it becomes a pick game — hold Flash for her root and never get caught alone in fog.

edits.before: With Q-W mark pressure you can two-spell stun an overstepping Neeko, and she has no dash to escape your E.
edits.after: Q-W mark pressure two-spell stuns an overstepping Neeko, but Tangle-Barbs roots from 1000 — further than your Q.

edits.before: Hextech Alternator/Rocketbelt cashes your three-mark R combo into a clean kill on her sub-200-HP frame.
edits.after: Hextech Alternator/Rocketbelt cashes your three-mark R combo into a clean kill while Tangle-Barbs is down.

edits.before: Second Q point plus Electrical Surge on-hit lets you chunk her every time she steps up to last-hit, and her short-range Q (Blooming Burst) can't trade back.
edits.after: Second Q point plus Electrical Surge on-hit chunks her every time she steps up to last-hit — Q (Blooming Burst) reaches 800 against your 950, so it cannot answer.

edits.before: Hextech Alternator/Rocketbelt turns your three-mark stun into a full kill on a sub-200-HP Neeko caught without her E up.
edits.after: Hextech Alternator/Rocketbelt turns your three-mark stun into a full kill on a Neeko caught with Tangle-Barbs down — 12s at rank 1.

edits.before: Bait or sidestep her Tangle-Barbs (E) root, then E-in, third-mark stun, R burst before she pools her cooldowns
edits.after: Sidestep her Tangle-Barbs (E, 12s at rank 1), then E-in, third-mark stun and R burst before it returns

notes: Only 82 games behind the 64.63% figure — the smallest sample in this slice, so the level chart was aligned to the prose and the packet rather than treated as high-confidence signal. phases[6].rating was left untouched at 5/10 because it already matches an even stage, so only the side/win pair is proposed for that row.
